entries.name: Hybrid six science packs · left in / right out · 60/min
setupNotes: Six science packs at 60/min each. Green/red circuits, engines, rails and ordinary science intermediates are made inside. Import the five heavy ingredients: processing units, low-density structures, flying robot frames, electric furnaces and productivity module 1s. All labeled material entrances are on the left; all six science collection chests are on the right. Keep circuit wires and stock controls. Normal AM2, fast inserters, red belts; no installed modules or bots. Factorio 2.1.24 flight-save recipes.
Input rates are recipe demand at exactly 60/min per pack. Supply surplus while startup stocks fill and if operating above the target.
Multiple iron, copper and steel entrances serve separate workshops; every entrance is labeled and faces left.
entries.attribution: Original local compact six-pack science design plus the parent-tested green-circuit, advanced-circuit and engine supply workshops. Frozen source components and SHA-256 identities are included. Hybrid placement and physical belt routing are new.
